title: Construct globally optimal private dyadic gauges for the complete P104 word
body:
The complete PR5822 private word now has optimal signed power-of-two representations under its retained scalar tariff. The actual allowance falls224976→224880 per call, saving1728 over18 calls. The emitted25963-instruction word changes70 source instructions and removes12 private SCALEs.

This is a coupled source-wide optimum:45 representation nodes in15 components, not per-buffer greedy choices. A spanning-tree argument bounds an attained optimum over all integer exponents. Exact threshold cuts from PR5783 and matching flow certificates then prove the minimum. The exponent objective falls61→24 and sign absorption saves22 more primitives.

Verification proves the exact representation invariant at every scalar event and every native call, then runs complete782-axis forward and611524-coefficient reverse checks. Native maps, paid ranks, targets, public boundaries and the12-slot pool stay fixed. Controls reject a false dual optimum and missing read compensation. Registered normal/-O, committed bytes, source hashes and a sealed empty-PATH Git-free replay pass.

This is a finite compiler-cost construction. It does not claim a new kappa, sharp rounded precision, global circuit minimum or physical reset/tape admission. Source native-phase and full caller proofs remain dependencies; all five assumptions and the selected frontier stay unchanged. Hosted CI and independent acceptance remain separate.

Retain the complete P104 credits in inputs/NOTICE and PR5822, and the PR5783 optimizer/dual checker credits. New construction by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents.
